ukm:Metadata.dc:title: Road Traffic (Fixed Penalty) (Offences) Order (Northern Ireland) 1997
ukm:Metadata.dc:subject: Vehicles
Road traffic offences
Taxi and minicab licences
Traffic management
Speed limits
ROAD TRAFFIC AND VEHICLES
ukm:Metadata.dc:description: This Order specifies the offences committed in respect of a vehicle under the various statutory provisions detailed in the Order, which are fixed penalty offences for the purposes of Part IV of the Road Traffic Offenders (Northern Ireland) Order 1996. Any liability to conviction of these offences may be discharged by the payment of a fixed penalty which at the coming into operation of this Order is—£20 for a fixed penalty offence which does not involve obligatory endorsement; and£40 for a fixed penalty offence involving obligatory endorsement,

tr.th: Offences under the Road Traffic (Northern Ireland) Order 1981

tr.td: Failure to comply with any conditions prescribed for driving under provisional licence.

Driving licence holder failing, when his licence is revoked, to surrender it and its counterpart or, when particulars cease to be correct, to surrender the licence and counterpart and give particulars.
Driving a goods vehicle or a public service vehicle in excess of prescribed hours.
Public service vehicle plying for hire when not licensed under Article 61.
Permitting overcrowding on a public service vehicle.
Failure to comply with conditions of LGV or PCV licence.
Driving a motor vehicle in contravention of applicable Community rules as to periods of driving, etc.
Contravention of requirement of applicable Community rules as to books, records or documents.
Refusal to submit to test to ascertain whether offence committed under Article 154(1).
Article 174B in relation to Regulation 7(4) of the Motor Vehicles (Taxi Drivers' Licences) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1991
Failure by a taxi driver to wear badge supplied by the Department.

tr.th: Offences under the Roads (Northern Ireland) Order 1993

tr.td: Wrongful use of a special road.
Depositing solid matter on the carriageway of a road.

tr.th: Offences under the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994

tr.td: Using or keeping a vehicle on public road without vehicle licence, trade licence or nil licence being exhibited in the prescribed manner.
Registration mark not fixed on vehicle as required by section 23.
Driving or keeping a vehicle with registration mark obscured, etc.
Section 59(1), in relation to regulation 18 of the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1973
Failure to display the correct size, shape and character of registration mark.

tr.th: Offences under the Road Traffic (Northern Ireland) Order 1995

tr.td: Driving or riding in a motor vehicle in contravention of regulations requiring the wearing of seat belts.
Driving motor vehicle with child in front not wearing seat belt.
Driving motor vehicle with child in rear not wearing seat belt.
Driving or riding motorcycles in contravention of regulations requiring wearing of protective headgear.
Prohibition of parking of heavy commercial vehicles on verges, etc.
Article 34 except when the offence is committed by the holder of a temporarily restricted licence during a period of restriction
Carrying of passengers on motor bicycles contrary to Article 34.
Holding or getting on to vehicle, etc., in order to be towed or carried.
Pedestrian endangering own safety or other’s safety.
Driving mechanically propelled vehicles elsewhere than on roads.
Failing to comply with traffic directions.
Failing to comply with traffic signs.
Using vehicle in dangerous condition, etc.
Breach of requirement as to brakes, steering-gear or tyres.
Breach of requirement as to weight: goods and passenger vehicles.
Breach of other construction and use requirements.
Using, etc., a motor vehicle without required test certificate being in force.
Using, etc., a goods vehicle without required goods vehicle test certificate being in force.
Driver of goods vehicle allowing unauthorised persons to be carried in vehicle; unauthorised persons being carried in goods vehicle.

tr.th: Offences under the Road Traffic Regulation (Northern Ireland) Order 1997

tr.td: Contravention of rule of road or overtaking incorrectly.
Contravention of an experimental traffic control scheme.
Contravention of a temporary prohibition or restriction.
Contravention of order as to use of a parking place on a road.
Certain contraventions of order relating to designated parking place by driver.
Other contraventions of order relating to designated parking place by driver or person.
Article 43 except when the offence is committed by the holder of a temporarily restricted licence during a period of restriction
Wrongful use of disabled person’s badge.
Failure to produce disabled person’s badge.
Contravention of regulations relating to pedestrian crossings.

tr.th: Offences against Regulations made under the Road Traffic (Northern Ireland) Order 1981

tr.td: Article 174B in relation to regulation 3 of the Road Vehicles (Traffic) Regulations 1933
Endangering other vehicles and pedestrians without reasonable cause by slowing down, stopping or turning to the right without having previously signalled intention to do so.
